User
definition:
model User {
  landlordVerification LandlordVerification? @relation("LandlordVerificationOwner")
  platformSubscription LandlordSubscription? @relation("LandlordSubscriptionOwner")
  billingCommands        BillingCommand[]
  billingReceipts        BillingReceipt[]
  billingPolicies        BillingReminderPolicy[]
  billingEvents          BillingOutboxEvent[]
  lifecycleRequests      TenantLifecycleRequest[]
  staffPropertyScopes    StaffPropertyScope[]
  supportViews           SupportSavedView[]
  supportSkills          SupportAgentSkill[]
  notificationPreference PlatformNotificationPreference?
  authSessions           AuthSession[]
  supportTickets         SupportTicket[]                 @relation("SupportRequester")
  supportAssignments     SupportTicket[]                 @relation("SupportAssignee")
  supportMessages        SupportMessage[]
  platformNotifications  PlatformNotification[]
  adminTeamMemberships   AdminTeamMember[]
  moderationAppeals      ModerationAppeal[]
  reportSchedules        AdminReportSchedule[]
  adminProfile           AdminProfile?
  accountTokens          AccountAccessToken[]
  tenantGroups           TenantGroup[]
  announcementTemplates  AnnouncementTemplate[]
  roomReviewsAuthored    RoomReview[]                    @relation("RoomReviewAuthor")
  roomReviewsReceived    RoomReview[]                    @relation("RoomReviewLandlord")
  sessionVersion         Int                             @default(0)
  uploadedFiles          UploadedFile[]
  savedSearches          SavedSearch[]
  savedListings          SavedListing[]
  viewingRequests        RoomViewing[]                   @relation("ViewingStudent")
  viewingAppointments    RoomViewing[]                   @relation("ViewingLandlord")
  housingNotifications   HousingNotification[]
  pilotFeedback          PilotFeedback[]
  listingReports         ListingReport[]
  id                     String                          @id @default(uuid())
  fullName               String
  email                  String                          @unique
  phone                  String?
  passwordHash           String
  role                   UserRole                        @default(LANDLORD)
  isActive               Boolean                         @default(true)
  refreshTokens          RefreshToken[]
  properties             Property[]
  tenants                Tenant[]                        @relation("LandlordTenants")
  tenantProfile          Tenant?                         @relation("TenantUser")
  staffProfile           StaffProfile?                   @relation("StaffUser")
  staffMembers           StaffProfile[]                  @relation("LandlordStaff")
  staffInvites           StaffInvite[]                   @relation("LandlordStaffInvites")
  tenantInvites          TenantInvite[]
  notificationReads      NotificationRead[]
  maintenanceComments    MaintenanceComment[]
  reviewedPaymentProofs  PaymentProof[]                  @relation("PaymentProofReviewer")
  depositTransactions    DepositTransaction[]
  leaseChanges           LeaseChange[]
  leaseSettlements       LeaseSettlement[]
  auditLogsAsLandlord    AuditLog[]                      @relation("LandlordAuditLogs")
  auditLogsAsActor       AuditLog[]                      @relation("ActorAuditLogs")
  billingAutomations     BillingAutomation[]
  roomTurnovers          RoomTurnover[]                  @relation("TurnoverLandlord")
  recurringOperations    RecurringOperation[]
  operationTasks         OperationTask[]
  announcements          Announcement[]
  paymentLinks           PaymentLink[]
  expenses               Expense[]
  maintenanceTickets     MaintenanceTicket[]
  knowledgeDocuments     KnowledgeDocument[]             @relation("KnowledgeLandlord")
  createdAt              DateTime                        @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime                        @updatedAt

  @@index([role])
}

name: KnowledgeDocument
definition:
model KnowledgeDocument {
  id                   String           @id @default(uuid())
  stableKey            String           @unique
  title                String
  scope                KnowledgeScope
  landlordId           String?
  propertyId           String?
  contentHash          String
  approvedBy           String
  approvedAt           DateTime
  active               Boolean          @default(true)
  embeddingModelDigest String
  embeddingDimensions  Int
  createdAt            DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime         @updatedAt
  landlord             User?            @relation("KnowledgeLandlord", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property             Property?        @relation(fields: [propertyId, landlordId], references: [id, landlordId], onDelete: Cascade)
  chunks               KnowledgeChunk[]

  @@index([active, scope, landlordId, propertyId, embeddingModelDigest], map: "KnowledgeDocument_active_scope_landlordId_propertyId_embeddingM")
}

name: KnowledgeChunk
definition:
model KnowledgeChunk {
  id         String            @id @default(uuid())
  documentId String
  ordinal    Int
  heading    String
  text       String
  embedding  Float[]
  document   KnowledgeDocument @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([documentId, ordinal])
  @@index([documentId])
}

name: KnowledgeScope
StaffProfile
definition:
model StaffProfile {
  maintenanceTickets MaintenanceTicket[]
  propertyScopes     StaffPropertyScope[]
  id                 String               @id @default(uuid())
  userId             String               @unique
  landlordId         String
  fullName           String
  phone              String?
  preset             String?
  permissions        String[]             @default([])
  isActive           Boolean              @default(true)
  user               User                 @relation("StaffUser", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  landlord           User                 @relation("LandlordStaff", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt          DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime             @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([landlordId, isActive])
}

name: StaffInvite
definition:
model StaffInvite {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId  String
  email       String
  fullName    String
  phone       String?
  preset      String?
  permissions String[]  @default([])
  propertyIds String[]  @default([])
  tokenHash   String    @unique
  expiresAt   DateTime
  acceptedAt  DateTime?
  landlord    User      @relation("LandlordStaffInvites", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([email])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

name: StaffPropertyScope
definition:
model StaffPropertyScope {
  id             String       @id @default(uuid())
  staffProfileId String
  propertyId     String
  landlordId     String
  staffProfile   StaffProfile @relation(fields: [staffProfileId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property       Property     @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  landlord       User         @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt      DateTime     @default(now())

  @@unique([staffProfileId, propertyId])
  @@index([landlordId, propertyId])
  @@index([staffProfileId])
}

name: AuditLog
definition:
model AuditLog {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId   String?
  actorId      String?
  actorRole    UserRole
  action       String
  resourceType String
  resourceId   String?
  summary      String
  metadata     Json?
  requestId    String?
  landlord     User?    @relation("LandlordAuditLogs", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  actor        User?    @relation("ActorAuditLogs", fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([actorId])
  @@index([action])
  @@index([resourceType])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([requestId])
}

name: Property
definition:
model Property {
  paymentAccount      PropertyPaymentAccount?
  approvalReview      PropertyApprovalReview?
  staffScopes         StaffPropertyScope[]
  billingPolicies     BillingReminderPolicy[]
  id                  String                  @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId          String
  name                String
  address             String                  @default("")
  isArchived          Boolean                 @default(false)
  landlord            User                    @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  rooms               Room[]
  billingAutomation   BillingAutomation?
  expenses            Expense[]
  maintenanceTickets  MaintenanceTicket[]
  roomTurnovers       RoomTurnover[]
  recurringOperations RecurringOperation[]
  operationTasks      OperationTask[]
  announcements       Announcement[]
  paymentLinks        PaymentLink[]
  knowledgeDocuments  KnowledgeDocument[]
  createdAt           DateTime                @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime                @updatedAt

  @@unique([id, landlordId])
  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([landlordId, isArchived])
}

name: PropertyPaymentAccount
definition:
model PropertyPaymentAccount {
  propertyId    String   @id
  bankName      String
  accountName   String
  accountNumber String
  qrImagePath   String?
  enabled       Boolean @default(true)
  version       Int     @default(1)
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
  property      Property @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

name: LandlordVerification
definition:
model LandlordVerification {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId   String   @unique
  ticketId     String
  status       String   @default("PENDING")
  version      Int      @default(1)
  reviewNote   String   @default("")
  reviewerId   String?
  reviewedAt   DateTime?
  submittedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
  landlord     User     @relation("LandlordVerificationOwner", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  ticket       SupportTicket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([status, submittedAt])
}

name: PropertyApprovalReview
definition:
model PropertyApprovalReview {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  propertyId   String   @unique
  property     Property @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  snapshotHash String
  status       String   @default("PENDING")
  version      Int      @default(1)
  reviewNote   String   @default("")
  reviewerId   String?
  reviewedAt   DateTime?
  submittedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([status, submittedAt])
}

name: ServicePlan
definition:
model ServicePlan {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  code          String   @unique
  name          String
  price         Int
  currency      String   @default("VND")
  interval      String   @default("MONTHLY")
  maxProperties Int
  maxRooms      Int
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  version       Int      @default(1)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
  subscriptions LandlordSubscription[]
}

name: LandlordSubscription
definition:
model LandlordSubscription {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId   String   @unique
  landlord     User     @relation("LandlordSubscriptionOwner", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  planId       String
  plan         ServicePlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  planSnapshot Json
  version      Int      @default(1)
  startsAt     DateTime @default(now())
  endsAt       DateTime?
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
  events       SubscriptionEvent[]
}

name: SubscriptionEvent
definition:
model SubscriptionEvent {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  subscriptionId String
  subscription   LandlordSubscription @relation(fields: [subscriptionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  actorId        String
  action         String
  snapshot       Json
  reason         String
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([subscriptionId, createdAt])
}

name: Room
definition:
model Room {
  requestedTransfers  TenantLifecycleRequest[]
  turnovers           RoomTurnover[]
  recurringOperations RecurringOperation[]
  operationTasks      OperationTask[]
  announcements       Announcement[]
  reviews             RoomReview[]
  listing             RoomListing?
  id                  String                   @id @default(uuid())
  propertyId          String
  name                String
  floor               Int?
  areaSqm             Float?
  basePrice           Int                      @default(0)
  status              RoomStatus               @default(VACANT)
  isActive            Boolean                  @default(true)
  capacity            Int?
  amenities           String[]                 @default([])
  imageUrl            String?
  tenantName          String?
  note                String?
  property            Property                 @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  leases              Lease[]
  assets              RoomAsset[]
  inspections         RoomInspection[]
  serviceFees         RoomServiceFee[]
  meterReadings       MeterReading[]
  invoices            Invoice[]
  expenses            Expense[]
  maintenanceTickets  MaintenanceTicket[]
  createdAt           DateTime                 @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime                 @updatedAt

  @@index([propertyId])
  @@index([propertyId, isActive])
}

name: ListingStatus
definition:
enum ListingStatus {
  DRAFT
  PENDING
  PUBLISHED
  REJECTED
  HIDDEN
}

name: RoomListing
definition:
model RoomListing {
  viewingSlots            ViewingSlot[]
  viewingSlotsRequired    Boolean            @default(false)
  searchMatches           SavedSearchMatch[]
  savedBy                 SavedListing[]
  viewings                RoomViewing[]
  id                      String             @id @default(uuid())
  roomId                  String             @unique
  room                    Room               @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title                   String
  description             String
  imageUrls               String[]
  city                    String
  district                String
  publicAddress           String
  monthlyRent             Int
  deposit                 Int                @default(0)
  electricityPrice        Int                @default(0)
  waterPrice              Int                @default(0)
  serviceFee              Int                @default(0)
  areaSqm                 Float
  amenities               String[]
  status                  ListingStatus      @default(DRAFT)
  version                 Int                @default(1)
  reviewNote              String?
  publishedAt             DateTime?
  latitude                Float?
  longitude               Float?
  parkingFee              Int                @default(0)
  availabilityConfirmedAt DateTime?
  landlordVerifiedAt      DateTime?
  inspectedAt             DateTime?
  reports                 ListingReport[]
  createdAt               DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime           @updatedAt

  @@index([status, publishedAt, id])
  @@index([city, district, monthlyRent])
  @@index([latitude, longitude])
}

name: ViewingStatus
definition:
enum ViewingStatus {
  REQUESTED
  CONFIRMED
  CANCELLED
  COMPLETED
  LEASED
}

name: SavedListing
definition:
model SavedListing {
  userId    String
  listingId String
  user      User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  listing   RoomListing @relation(fields: [listingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now())

  @@id([userId, listingId])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

name: RoomViewing
definition:
model RoomViewing {
  id                 String        @id @default(uuid())
  listingId          String
  studentId          String
  landlordId         String
  scheduledAt        DateTime
  endsAt             DateTime
  slotId             String?
  slot               ViewingSlot?  @relation(fields: [slotId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  cancellationReason String        @default("")
  reminderSentAt     DateTime?
  status             ViewingStatus @default(REQUESTED)
  version            Int           @default(1)
  activeKey          String?       @unique
  note               String        @default("")
  responseNote       String        @default("")
  leaseId            String?       @unique
  listing            RoomListing   @relation(fields: [listingId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  student            User          @relation("ViewingStudent", fields: [studentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  landlord           User          @relation("ViewingLandlord", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  lease              Lease?        @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdAt          DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime      @updatedAt

  @@index([studentId, scheduledAt])
  @@index([landlordId, scheduledAt])
  @@index([status, scheduledAt, reminderSentAt])
}

name: ViewingSlot
definition:
model ViewingSlot {
  id        String        @id @default(uuid())
  listingId String
  startsAt  DateTime
  endsAt    DateTime
  listing   RoomListing   @relation(fields: [listingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  viewings  RoomViewing[]
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())

  @@index([listingId, startsAt])
}

name: HousingNotification
definition:
model HousingNotification {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  viewingId String
  message   String
  readAt    DateTime?
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

name: PilotFeedback
definition:
model PilotFeedback {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  stage     String
  area      String
  rating    Int
  detail    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([area, createdAt])
}

name: SchoolCampus
definition:
model SchoolCampus {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  campus    String
  city      String
  address   String
  latitude  Float
  longitude Float
  isDemo    Boolean  @default(false)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  sourceUrl String?
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

name: UploadedFile
definition:
model UploadedFile {
  supportAttachment SupportAttachment?
  filename          String             @id
  ownerId           String
  owner             User               @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mimeType          String
  purpose           String             @default("PRIVATE")
  createdAt         DateTime           @default(now())

  @@index([ownerId])
}

name: SavedSearch
definition:
model SavedSearch {
  id        String             @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name      String
  filters   Json
  enabled   Boolean            @default(true)
  checkedAt DateTime           @default(now())
  createdAt DateTime           @default(now())
  matches   SavedSearchMatch[]

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

name: SavedSearchMatch
definition:
model SavedSearchMatch {
  id            String      @id @default(uuid())
  savedSearchId String
  listingId     String
  search        SavedSearch @relation(fields: [savedSearchId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  listing       RoomListing @relation(fields: [listingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  readAt        DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime    @default(now())

  @@unique([savedSearchId, listingId])
}

name: ListingReport
definition:
model ListingReport {
  version    Int         @default(1)
  id         String      @id @default(uuid())
  listingId  String
  reporterId String
  reason     String
  detail     String
  status     String      @default("OPEN")
  reviewNote String?
  reviewedAt DateTime?
  listing    RoomListing @relation(fields: [listingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reporter   User        @relation(fields: [reporterId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime    @default(now())

  @@unique([listingId, reporterId])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
}

name: RoomAsset
definition:
model RoomAsset {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  roomId      String
  name        String
  quantity    Int       @default(1)
  condition   String    @default("good")
  value       Int?
  purchasedAt DateTime?
  note        String?
  imageUrl    String?
  room        Room      @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([roomId])
}

name: RoomInspection
definition:
model RoomInspection {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  roomId      String
  title       String
  dueAt       DateTime
  completedAt DateTime?
  note        String?
  room        Room      @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([roomId])
  @@index([dueAt])
  @@index([completedAt])
}

name: RoomServiceFee
definition:
model RoomServiceFee {
  id        String                 @id @default(uuid())
  roomId    String
  name      String
  amount    Int
  isActive  Boolean                @default(true)
  note      String?
  room      Room                   @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime               @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime               @updatedAt
  versions  ServiceTariffVersion[]

  @@index([roomId])
  @@index([roomId, isActive])
}

name: ServiceTariffVersion
definition:
model ServiceTariffVersion {
  id            String            @id @default(uuid())
  serviceFeeId  String
  version       Int
  name          String
  unit          String            @default("thang")
  amount        Int
  isActive      Boolean           @default(true)
  effectiveFrom DateTime
  note          String?
  createdAt     DateTime          @default(now())
  serviceFee    RoomServiceFee    @relation(fields: [serviceFeeId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  invoiceLines  InvoiceLineItem[]

  @@unique([serviceFeeId, version])
  @@unique([serviceFeeId, effectiveFrom])
}

name: InvoiceLineItem
definition:
model InvoiceLineItem {
  id              String                @id @default(uuid())
  invoiceId       String
  position        Int
  kind            String
  description     String
  quantity        Int
  unit            String
  unitPrice       Int
  amount          Int
  source          String
  sourceId        String?
  tariffVersionId String?
  tariffVersion   Int?
  invoice         Invoice               @relation(fields: [invoiceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tariff          ServiceTariffVersion? @relation(fields: [tariffVersionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([invoiceId, position])
  @@index([tariffVersionId])
}

name: Tenant
definition:
model Tenant {
  billingReceipts        BillingReceipt[]
  billingNotifications   BillingNotification[]
  id                     String                        @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId             String
  userId                 String?                       @unique
  fullName               String
  phone                  String?
  idNumber               String?
  note                   String?
  isActive               Boolean                       @default(true)
  landlord               User                          @relation("LandlordTenants", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user                   User?                         @relation("TenantUser", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  leases                 Lease[]
  invoices               Invoice[]
  invites                TenantInvite[]
  paymentProofs          PaymentProof[]
  paymentLinks           PaymentLink[]
  announcementRecipients AnnouncementRecipient[]
  createdAt              DateTime                      @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime                      @updatedAt
  occupants              TenantOccupant[]
  lifecycleRequests      TenantLifecycleRequest[]
  notificationPreference TenantNotificationPreference?

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([landlordId, isActive])
}

name: TenantOccupant
definition:
model TenantOccupant {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId     String
  leaseId      String
  fullName     String
  phone        String?
  idNumber     String?
  relationship String?
  tenant       Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lease        Lease    @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([leaseId])
}

name: TenantLifecycleRequest
definition:
model TenantLifecycleRequest {
  execution       TenantLifecycleExecution?
  id              String                       @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId      String
  tenantId        String
  leaseId         String?
  requestedRoomId String?
  type            TenantLifecycleRequestType
  status          TenantLifecycleRequestStatus @default(PENDING)
  requestedStart  DateTime?
  requestedEnd    DateTime?
  note            String?
  decisionNote    String?
  reviewedById    String?
  reviewedAt      DateTime?
  tenant          Tenant                       @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lease           Lease?                       @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  requestedRoom   Room?                        @relation(fields: [requestedRoomId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  landlord        User                         @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt       DateTime                     @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime                     @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId, status, createdAt])
  @@index([tenantId, createdAt])
}

name: TenantLifecycleExecution
definition:
model TenantLifecycleExecution {
  id              String                 @id @default(uuid())
  requestId       String                 @unique
  requestKey      String                 @unique
  requestHash     String
  resultLeaseId   String?
  actorId         String
  createdAt       DateTime               @default(now())
  request         TenantLifecycleRequest @relation(fields: [requestId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

name: TenantNotificationPreference
definition:
model TenantNotificationPreference {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId  String   @unique
  channels  String[] @default(["APP"])
  enabled   Boolean  @default(true)
  tenant    Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

name: TenantInvite
definition:
model TenantInvite {
  id         String    @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId String
  tenantId   String
  email      String
  tokenHash  String    @unique
  expiresAt  DateTime
  acceptedAt DateTime?
  landlord   User      @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tenant     Tenant    @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([email])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

name: Lease
definition:
model Lease {
  occupants           TenantOccupant[]
  lifecycleRequests   TenantLifecycleRequest[]
  review              RoomReview?
  handover            LeaseHandover?
  viewing             RoomViewing?
  id                  String                   @id @default(uuid())
  roomId              String
  tenantId            String
  startDate           DateTime
  endDate             DateTime?
  monthlyRent         Int
  deposit             Int                      @default(0)
  status              LeaseStatus              @default(ACTIVE)
  room                Room                     @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tenant              Tenant                   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  invoices            Invoice[]
  roomTurnovers       RoomTurnover[]
  depositTransactions DepositTransaction[]
  changes             LeaseChange[]
  settlement          LeaseSettlement?
  createdAt           DateTime                 @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime                 @updatedAt

  @@index([roomId])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([status])
}

name: RoomReviewStatus
RoomReview
definition:
model RoomReview {
  id                  String            @id @default(uuid())
  leaseId             String            @unique
  roomId              String
  authorId            String
  landlordId          String
  lease               Lease             @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room                Room              @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  author              User              @relation("RoomReviewAuthor", fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  landlord            User              @relation("RoomReviewLandlord", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  roomRating          Int
  costRating          Int
  landlordRating      Int
  areaRating          Int
  body                String
  status              RoomReviewStatus  @default(PENDING)
  version             Int               @default(1)
  verificationSource  String
  tenancyVerifiedAt   DateTime
  moderationNote      String?
  reviewedById        String?
  reviewedAt          DateTime?
  withdrawnAt         DateTime?
  replyBody           String?
  replyStatus         RoomReviewStatus?
  replyModerationNote String?
  replyReviewedById   String?
  replyReviewedAt     DateTime?
  createdAt           DateTime          @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime          @updatedAt

  @@unique([authorId, roomId, landlordId])
  @@index([roomId, landlordId, status])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([replyStatus, updatedAt])
  @@index([landlordId, createdAt])
}

name: LeaseHandover
definition:
model LeaseHandover {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  leaseId     String    @unique
  lease       Lease     @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  version     Int       @default(1)
  electricity Int
  water       Int
  condition   String
  imageUrls   String[]
  acceptedAt  DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
}

name: DepositTransaction
definition:
model DepositTransaction {
  id         String                 @id @default(uuid())
  leaseId    String
  landlordId String
  type       DepositTransactionType
  amount     Int
  occurredAt DateTime               @default(now())
  note       String?
  lease      Lease                  @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  landlord   User                   @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime               @default(now())

  @@index([leaseId])
  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([occurredAt])
}

name: LeaseChange
definition:
model LeaseChange {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  leaseId        String
  landlordId     String
  changeType     String
  previousValues Json
  newValues      Json
  note           String?
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  lease          Lease    @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  landlord       User     @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([leaseId])
  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

name: LeaseSettlement
definition:
model LeaseSettlement {
  id                       String                @id @default(uuid())
  leaseId                  String                @unique
  landlordId               String
  status                   LeaseSettlementStatus @default(CONFIRMED)
  version                  Int                   @default(1)
  moveOutDate              DateTime
  rentAmount               Int
  electricityAmount        Int                   @default(0)
  waterAmount              Int                   @default(0)
  otherCharges             Int                   @default(0)
  totalCharges             Int
  depositBalance           Int
  depositApplied           Int                   @default(0)
  refundAmount             Int                   @default(0)
  refundStatus             String                @default("NOT_DUE")
  refundReference          String?
  refundPaidAt             DateTime?
  refundRequestKey         String?               @unique
  balanceDue               Int                   @default(0)
  outstandingInvoiceAmount Int                   @default(0)
  requestKey               String
  requestHash              String
  previewFingerprint       String
  snapshot                 Json
  note                     String?
  confirmedAt              DateTime              @default(now())
  lease                    Lease                 @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  landlord                 User                  @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  lines                    LeaseSettlementLine[]
  createdAt                DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt                DateTime              @updatedAt

  @@unique([landlordId, requestKey])
  @@index([landlordId, confirmedAt])
  @@index([status, confirmedAt])
}

name: LeaseSettlementLine
definition:
model LeaseSettlementLine {
  id           String          @id @default(uuid())
  settlementId String
  kind         String
  description  String
  amount       Int
  settlement   LeaseSettlement @relation(fields: [settlementId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt    DateTime        @default(now())

  @@index([settlementId])
}

name: NotificationRead
definition:
model NotificationRead {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId         String
  notificationId String
  readAt         DateTime @default(now())
  user           User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, notificationId])
  @@index([userId])
}

name: NotificationDelivery
definition:
model NotificationDelivery {
  id                String                      @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId        String
  tenantId          String?
  invoiceId         String?
  channel           NotificationDeliveryChannel
  purpose           String
  recipient         String
  templateId        String?
  status            NotificationDeliveryStatus  @default(PENDING)
  payload           Json?
  providerMessageId String?
  errorCode         String?
  errorMessage      String?
  sentAt            DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime                    @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime                    @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([invoiceId])
  @@index([channel])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([purpose])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

name: MeterReading
definition:
model MeterReading {
  id              String      @id @default(uuid())
  roomId          String
  utilityType     UtilityType
  billingMonth    DateTime
  previousReading Int
  currentReading  Int
  unitPrice       Int
  usage           Int
  amount          Int
  note            String?
  room            Room        @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt       DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime    @updatedAt

  @@unique([roomId, utilityType, billingMonth])
  @@index([roomId])
  @@index([billingMonth])
}

name: Invoice
definition:
model Invoice {
  billingNotifications BillingNotification[]
  revision             Int                   @default(1)
  replacesInvoiceId    String?               @unique
  replacesInvoice      Invoice?              @relation("InvoiceReplacement", fields: [replacesInvoiceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  replacementInvoice   Invoice?              @relation("InvoiceReplacement")
  adjustments          InvoiceAdjustment[]
  lineItems            InvoiceLineItem[]
  paymentLinks         PaymentLink[]
  id                   String                @id @default(uuid())
  leaseId              String
  roomId               String
  tenantId             String
  billingMonth         DateTime
  rentAmount           Int
  electricityAmount    Int                   @default(0)
  waterAmount          Int                   @default(0)
  otherAmount          Int                   @default(0)
  totalAmount          Int
  paidAmount           Int                   @default(0)
  isDemo               Boolean               @default(false)
  status               InvoiceStatus         @default(UNPAID)
  dueDate              DateTime?
  issuedAt             DateTime              @default(now())
  note                 String?
  cancelledAt          DateTime?
  cancelledNote        String?
  lease                Lease                 @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room                 Room                  @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tenant               Tenant                @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  payments             Payment[]
  paymentProofs        PaymentProof[]
  createdAt            DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime              @updatedAt

  @@unique([leaseId, billingMonth, isDemo, revision])
  @@index([roomId])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([billingMonth])
}

name: PaymentProof
definition:
model PaymentProof {
  requestKey     String?            @unique
  requestHash    String?
  id             String             @id @default(uuid())
  invoiceId      String
  tenantId       String
  amount         Int
  method         PaymentMethod      @default(BANK_TRANSFER)
  note           String?
  proofImageUrls String[]           @default([])
  status         PaymentProofStatus @default(PENDING)
  submittedAt    DateTime           @default(now())
  reviewedAt     DateTime?
  reviewedById   String?
  reviewNote     String?
  invoice        Invoice            @relation(fields: [invoiceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tenant         Tenant             @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reviewedBy     User?              @relation("PaymentProofReviewer", fields: [reviewedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([invoiceId])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([submittedAt])
}

name: Payment
definition:
model Payment {
  allocation          PaymentAllocation?
  statementLine       FinanceStatementLine?
  id                  String                @id @default(uuid())
  invoiceId           String
  amount              Int
  method              PaymentMethod         @default(CASH)
  type                PaymentType           @default(PAYMENT)
  reversalOfPaymentId String?               @unique
  paidAt              DateTime              @default(now())
  note                String?
  invoice             Invoice               @relation(fields: [invoiceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reversalOfPayment   Payment?              @relation("PaymentReversal", fields: [reversalOfPaymentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reversalPayment     Payment?              @relation("PaymentReversal")
  createdAt           DateTime              @default(now())

  @@index([invoiceId])
  @@index([paidAt])
  @@index([type])
}

name: BillingCommand
definition:
model BillingCommand {
  landlord    User     @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId  String
  requestKey  String
  requestHash String
  response    Json
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([landlordId, requestKey])
}

name: InvoiceAdjustment
definition:
model InvoiceAdjustment {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  invoiceId String
  kind      String
  category  String
  amount    Int
  reason    String
  actorId   String
  lineId    String   @unique
  invoice   Invoice  @relation(fields: [invoiceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([invoiceId, createdAt])
}

name: BillingReceipt
definition:
model BillingReceipt {
  statementLine   FinanceStatementLine?
  landlord        User                  @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tenant          Tenant                @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  id              String                @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId      String
  tenantId        String
  amount          Int
  availableAmount Int
  refundedAmount  Int                   @default(0)
  method          PaymentMethod
  reference       String
  paidAt          DateTime
  actorId         String
  createdAt       DateTime              @default(now())
  allocations     PaymentAllocation[]
  refunds         BillingRefund[]

  @@index([landlordId, tenantId, paidAt])
}

name: PaymentAllocation
definition:
model PaymentAllocation {
  id            String         @id @default(uuid())
  receiptId     String
  paymentId     String         @unique
  amount        Int
  releasedAt    DateTime?
  releaseReason String?
  releasedBy    String?
  receipt       BillingReceipt @relation(fields: [receiptId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  payment       Payment        @relation(fields: [paymentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  createdAt     DateTime       @default(now())

  @@index([receiptId, releasedAt])
}

name: BillingRefund
definition:
model BillingRefund {
  id        String         @id @default(uuid())
  receiptId String
  amount    Int
  reason    String
  reference String
  actorId   String
  receipt   BillingReceipt @relation(fields: [receiptId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now())

  @@index([receiptId, createdAt])
}

name: BillingReminderPolicy
definition:
model BillingReminderPolicy {
  landlord    User      @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property    Property? @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId  String
  scopeKey    String    @unique
  propertyId  String?
  enabled     Boolean   @default(false)
  beforeDays  Int[]     @default([3, 1])
  onDueDate   Boolean   @default(true)
  overdueDays Int[]     @default([1, 7, 30])
  channels    String[]  @default(["APP"])
  version     Int       @default(1)
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId])
}

name: BillingOutboxEvent
definition:
model BillingOutboxEvent {
  landlord    User      @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId  String
  eventKey    String    @unique
  type        String
  resourceId  String
  payload     Json
  status      String    @default("PENDING")
  attempts    Int       @default(0)
  availableAt DateTime  @default(now())
  leaseOwner  String?
  leaseUntil  DateTime?
  lastError   String?
  completedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([status, availableAt])
  @@index([landlordId, createdAt])
}

name: BillingNotification
definition:
model BillingNotification {
  tenant    Tenant    @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  invoice   Invoice   @relation(fields: [invoiceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId  String
  invoiceId String
  eventKey  String    @unique
  title     String
  body      String
  readAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([tenantId, createdAt])
}

name: BillingTariffVersion
definition:
model BillingTariffVersion {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId    String
  propertyId    String
  roomId        String?
  scopeKey      String
  serviceKey    String
  name          String
  kind          String
  unit          String
  amount        Int
  tiers         Json
  effectiveFrom DateTime
  version       Int
  state         String    @default("PROPOSED")
  isActive      Boolean   @default(true)
  makerId       String
  checkerId     String?
  reason        String
  reviewReason  String?
  reviewedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())

  @@unique([scopeKey, serviceKey, version])
  @@index([propertyId, state, effectiveFrom])
  @@index([roomId, state, effectiveFrom])
}

name: BillingPeriodLock
definition:
model BillingPeriodLock {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  propertyId String
  month      DateTime
  reason     String
  actorId    String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([propertyId, month])
}

name: BillingAutomation
definition:
model BillingAutomation {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId   String
  propertyId   String    @unique
  isEnabled    Boolean   @default(false)
  invoiceDay   Int       @default(1)
  dueDay       Int       @default(10)
  lastRunMonth DateTime?
  lastRunAt    DateTime?
  landlord     User      @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property     Property  @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([isEnabled])
  @@index([lastRunMonth])
}

name: Expense
definition:
model Expense {
  id                 String              @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId         String
  propertyId         String
  roomId             String?
  category           ExpenseCategory
  amount             Int
  expenseDate        DateTime
  title              String
  note               String?
  receiptUrl         String?
  landlord           User                @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property           Property            @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room               Room?               @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  maintenanceTickets MaintenanceTicket[]
  createdAt          DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime            @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([propertyId])
  @@index([roomId])
  @@index([expenseDate])
  @@index([category])
}

name: MaintenanceTicket
definition:
model MaintenanceTicket {
  id                     String               @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId             String
  propertyId             String
  roomId                 String
  status                 MaintenanceStatus    @default(OPEN)
  priority               MaintenancePriority  @default(MEDIUM)
  title                  String
  description            String?
  reportedAt             DateTime             @default(now())
  startedAt              DateTime?
  completedAt            DateTime?
  estimatedCost          Int?
  actualCost             Int?
  note                   String?
  imageUrls              String[]             @default([])
  expenseId              String?
  assigneeStaffProfileId String?
  dueAt                  DateTime?
  escalatedAt            DateTime?
  comments               MaintenanceComment[]
  landlord               User                 @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property               Property             @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room                   Room                 @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  expense                Expense?             @relation(fields: [expenseId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  assignee               StaffProfile?        @relation(fields: [assigneeStaffProfileId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdAt              DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime             @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId])
  @@index([propertyId])
  @@index([roomId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([priority])
  @@index([reportedAt])
  @@index([assigneeStaffProfileId, status, dueAt])
}

name: MaintenanceComment
definition:
model MaintenanceComment {
  id         String            @id @default(uuid())
  ticketId   String
  authorId   String
  authorRole UserRole
  body       String
  imageUrls  String[]          @default([])
  ticket     MaintenanceTicket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  author     User              @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime          @default(now())

  @@index([ticketId])
  @@index([authorId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

name: RoomTurnover
definition:
model RoomTurnover {
  id          String         @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId  String
  propertyId  String
  roomId      String
  leaseId     String?        @unique
  stage       TurnoverStage  @default(RETURNED)
  status      TurnoverStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  version     Int            @default(1)
  note        String?
  completedAt DateTime?
  landlord    User           @relation("TurnoverLandlord", fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property    Property       @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room        Room           @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lease       Lease?         @relation(fields: [leaseId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  steps       TurnoverStep[]
  createdAt   DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime       @updatedAt

  @@index([landlordId, status, createdAt])
  @@index([roomId, status])
}

name: TurnoverStep
definition:
model TurnoverStep {
  id          String        @id @default(uuid())
  turnoverId  String
  stage       TurnoverStage
  title       String
  completedAt DateTime?
  completedBy String?
  note        String?
  turnover    RoomTurnover  @relation(fields: [turnoverId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([turnoverId, stage])
}

name: RecurringOperation
definition:
model RecurringOperation {
  id         String             @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId String
  propertyId String
  roomId     String?
  title      String
  kind       String
  frequency  OperationFrequency
  interval   Int                @default(1)
  anchorDay  Int
  nextRunAt  DateTime
  checklist  String[]
  isEnabled  Boolean            @default(true)
  landlord   User               @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property   Property           @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room       Room?              @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tasks      OperationTask[]
  createdAt  DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime           @updatedAt

  @@index([isEnabled, nextRunAt])
  @@index([landlordId, propertyId])
}

name: OperationTask
definition:
model OperationTask {
  id          String              @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId  String
  propertyId  String
  roomId      String?
  recurringId String
  title       String
  kind        String
  dueAt       DateTime
  checklist   Json
  version     Int                 @default(1)
  status      OperationTaskStatus @default(PENDING)
  completedAt DateTime?
  completedBy String?
  landlord    User                @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property    Property            @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room        Room?               @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  recurring   RecurringOperation  @relation(fields: [recurringId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt   DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime            @updatedAt

  @@unique([recurringId, dueAt])
  @@index([landlordId, status, dueAt])
}

name: TenantGroup
definition:
model TenantGroup {
  landlord   User     @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId String
  name       String
  tenantIds  String[]
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([landlordId])
}

name: AnnouncementTemplate
definition:
model AnnouncementTemplate {
  landlord   User     @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId String
  name       String
  title      String
  body       String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([landlordId])
}

name: Announcement
definition:
model Announcement {
  id         String                  @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId String
  propertyId String?
  roomId     String?
  groupId    String?
  tenantIds  String[]                @default([])
  audience   AnnouncementAudience
  title      String
  body       String
  status     AnnouncementStatus      @default(SCHEDULED)
  sendAt     DateTime                @default(now())
  sentAt     DateTime?
  landlord   User                    @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property   Property?               @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  room       Room?                   @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  recipients AnnouncementRecipient[]
  createdAt  DateTime                @default(now())

  @@index([status, sendAt])
  @@index([landlordId, createdAt])
}

name: AnnouncementRecipient
definition:
model AnnouncementRecipient {
  announcementId String
  tenantId       String
  readAt         DateTime?
  announcement   Announcement @relation(fields: [announcementId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tenant         Tenant       @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([announcementId, tenantId])
  @@index([tenantId, readAt])
}

name: PaymentLink
definition:
model PaymentLink {
  id            String                @id @default(uuid())
  landlordId    String
  propertyId    String
  invoiceId     String
  tenantId      String
  orderCode     Int                   @unique @default(autoincrement())
  amount        Int
  provider      PaymentProvider       @default(DEMO_CARD)
  status        PaymentLinkStatus     @default(PENDING)
  providerId    String?               @unique
  checkoutUrl   String?
  qrCode        String?
  bankBin       String?
  accountNumber String?
  accountName   String?
  description   String?
  expiresAt     DateTime
  paidAt        DateTime?
  landlord      User                  @relation(fields: [landlordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  property      Property              @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  invoice       Invoice               @relation(fields: [invoiceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tenant        Tenant                @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  events        PaymentWebhookEvent[]
  demoSession   DemoCheckoutSession?
  createdAt     DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime              @updatedAt

  @@index([invoiceId, status])
  @@index([landlordId, createdAt])
}

name: DemoCheckoutSession
definition:
model DemoCheckoutSession {
  id            String             @id @default(uuid())
  paymentLinkId String             @unique
  tokenHash     String             @unique
  status        DemoCheckoutStatus @default(PENDING)
  expiresAt     DateTime
  completedAt   DateTime?
  cardBrand     String?
  cardLast4     String?
  paymentLink   PaymentLink        @relation(fields: [paymentLinkId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt     DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime           @updatedAt

  @@index([expiresAt, status])
}

name: PaymentWebhookEvent
definition:
model PaymentWebhookEvent {
  landlordId    String
  id            String      @id @default(uuid())
  paymentLinkId String
  reference     String
  amount        Int
  status        String
  reason        String?
  paymentId     String?
  paymentLink   PaymentLink @relation(fields: [paymentLinkId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt     DateTime    @default(now())

  @@unique([paymentLinkId, reference])
  @@unique([landlordId, reference])
}

name: RefreshToken
definition:
model RefreshToken {
  sessionId         String?
  session           AuthSession? @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mfaVerified       Boolean      @default(false)
  id                String       @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String
  tokenHash         String       @unique
  expiresAt         DateTime
  revokedAt         DateTime?
  replacedByTokenId String?
  user              User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt         DateTime     @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@index([sessionId])
}

name: AuthSession
definition:
model AuthSession {
  stepUpGrants AdminStepUpGrant[]
  id           String             @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String
  user         User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userVersion  Int
  device       String             @default("Unknown device")
  ip           String?
  lastSeenAt   DateTime           @default(now())
  expiresAt    DateTime
  revokedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt    DateTime           @default(now())
  tokens       RefreshToken[]

  @@index([userId, revokedAt, expiresAt])
}

name: AdminProfile
definition:
model AdminProfile {
  accessReviewedAt   DateTime?
  accessReviewedBy   String?
  nextAccessReviewAt DateTime?
  reviewVersion      Int       @default(1)
  userId             String    @id
  preset             String
  permissions        String[]
  mfaSecret          String?
  mfaEnabled         Boolean   @default(false)
  mfaLastCounter     BigInt    @default(-1)
  recoveryHashes     String[]  @default([])
  user               User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  updatedAt          DateTime  @updatedAt
}

name: AccountAccessToken
definition:
model AccountAccessToken {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String
  purpose    String
  tokenHash  String       @unique
  expiresAt  DateTime
  consumedAt DateTime?
  user       User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now())
  delivery   DeliveryJob?

  @@index([userId, purpose])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

name: ModerationWorkItem
definition:
model ModerationWorkItem {
  escalatedAt DateTime?
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  kind        String
  targetId    String
  assigneeId  String?
  priority    String    @default("NORMAL")
  dueAt       DateTime
  note        String    @default("")
  version     Int       @default(1)
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())

  @@unique([kind, targetId])
  @@index([assigneeId, dueAt])
}

name: DeliveryJob
definition:
model DeliveryJob {
  id          String              @id @default(uuid())
  kind        String
  tokenId     String?             @unique
  token       AccountAccessToken? @relation(fields: [tokenId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  payload     String?
  status      String              @default("PENDING")
  attempts    Int                 @default(0)
  availableAt DateTime            @default(now())
  expiresAt   DateTime
  leaseUntil  DateTime?
  leaseOwner  String?
  lastError   String?
  deliveredAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime            @updatedAt

  @@index([status, availableAt])
  @@index([leaseUntil])
}

name: OperationsMetric
definition:
model OperationsMetric {
  minute        DateTime @id
  requests      Int      @default(0)
  errors        Int      @default(0)
  loginFailures Int      @default(0)
  mfaFailures   Int      @default(0)
  durationMs    Int      @default(0)
}

name: WorkerHeartbeat
OperationsIncident
definition:
model OperationsIncident {
  ownerId         String?
  conditionActive Boolean   @default(true)
  snoozedUntil    DateTime?
  resolutionNote  String?
  resolvedBy      String?
  id              String    @id @default(uuid())
  key             String    @unique
  severity        String
  title           String
  status          String    @default("OPEN")
  occurrences     Int       @default(1)
  firstSeenAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  lastSeenAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  resolvedAt      DateTime?
  acknowledgedBy  String?
  version         Int       @default(1)

  @@index([status, snoozedUntil])
  @@index([ownerId, status])
}

name: SupportTicket
definition:
model SupportTicket {
  verificationRequests LandlordVerification[]
  caseLinks          SupportCaseLink[]
  escalations        SupportEscalation[]
  slaSnapshot        Json?
  slaPausedAt        DateTime?
  slaCheckedAt       DateTime?
  attachments        SupportAttachment[]
  labels             String[]            @default([])
  mergedIntoId       String?
  feedbackRating     Int?
  feedbackComment    String?
  feedbackAt         DateTime?
  id                 String              @id @default(uuid())
  requesterId        String
  requester          User                @relation("SupportRequester", fields: [requesterId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  subject            String
  category           String
  status             String              @default("OPEN")
  priority           String              @default("NORMAL")
  assigneeId         String?
  assignee           User?               @relation("SupportAssignee", fields: [assigneeId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  teamId             String?
  team               AdminTeam?          @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  version            Int                 @default(1)
  firstResponseDueAt DateTime
  resolutionDueAt    DateTime
  firstRespondedAt   DateTime?
  resolvedAt         DateTime?
  messages           SupportMessage[]
  createdAt          DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime            @updatedAt

  @@index([requesterId, updatedAt])
  @@index([status, resolutionDueAt])
  @@index([assigneeId, status])
  @@index([teamId])
  @@index([slaCheckedAt])
}

name: AdminStepUpGrant
definition:
model AdminStepUpGrant {
  id          String      @id @default(uuid())
  tokenHash   String      @unique
  sessionId   String
  session     AuthSession @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId      String
  action      String
  fingerprint String
  expiresAt   DateTime
  consumedAt  DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime    @default(now())

  @@index([expiresAt])
}

name: SupportSlaPolicy
definition:
model SupportSlaPolicy {
  id                String   @id @default("platform")
  enabled           Boolean  @default(false)
  timezone          String   @default("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")
  weekdays          Int[]    @default([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
  startMinute       Int      @default(540)
  endMinute         Int      @default(1020)
  holidays          String[] @default([])
  pauseWaiting      Boolean  @default(false)
  responseMinutes   Json
  resolutionMinutes Json
  escalationMinutes Int[]    @default([0, 240, 1440])
  version           Int      @default(1)
  updatedById       String
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
}

name: SupportEscalation
definition:
model SupportEscalation {
  id         String        @id @default(uuid())
  ticketId   String
  ticket     SupportTicket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  kind       String
  deadlineAt DateTime
  level      Int
  createdAt  DateTime      @default(now())

  @@unique([ticketId, kind, deadlineAt, level])
}

name: SupportCaseLink
definition:
model SupportCaseLink {
  id          String        @id @default(uuid())
  ticketId    String
  ticket      SupportTicket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  kind        String
  targetId    String
  createdById String
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now())

  @@unique([ticketId, kind, targetId])
}

name: SupportMessage
definition:
model SupportMessage {
  id         String        @id @default(uuid())
  ticketId   String
  ticket     SupportTicket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId   String?
  author     User?         @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  authorRole String
  body       String
  internal   Boolean       @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime      @default(now())

  @@index([ticketId, createdAt])
}

name: SupportTemplate
definition:
model SupportTemplate {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  title       String   @unique
  body        String
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  version     Int      @default(1)
  updatedById String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

name: PlatformNotification
definition:
model PlatformNotification {
  deliveries PlatformNotificationDelivery[]
  id         String                         @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String
  user       User                           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  eventKey   String
  kind       String
  title      String
  body       String
  actionPath String
  readAt     DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime                       @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, eventKey])
  @@index([userId, readAt, createdAt])
}

name: ModerationDecision
definition:
model ModerationDecision {
  qualityReview ModerationQualityReview?
  evidence   Json?
  policyId   String?
  policy     ModerationPolicy?  @relation(fields: [policyId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  id         String             @id @default(uuid())
  kind       String
  targetId   String
  actorId    String
  ownerId    String
  fromStatus String
  toStatus   String
  version    Int
  reason     String
  requestId  String?
  source     String             @default("REVIEW")
  appeals    ModerationAppeal[]
  createdAt  DateTime           @default(now())

  @@unique([kind, targetId, version])
  @@index([ownerId, createdAt])
  @@index([kind, createdAt])
}

name: ModerationQualityReview
definition:
model ModerationQualityReview {
  id         String @id @default(uuid())
  decisionId String @unique
  decision   ModerationDecision @relation(fields: [decisionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  reviewerId String
  outcome    String
  reason     String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([createdAt, outcome])
}

name: ModerationPolicy
definition:
model ModerationPolicy {
  id            String               @id @default(uuid())
  kind          String
  version       Int
  title         String
  body          String
  status        String               @default("DRAFT")
  createdById   String
  activatedById String?
  activatedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime             @default(now())
  decisions     ModerationDecision[]

  @@unique([kind, version])
  @@index([kind, status])
}

name: ModerationAppeal
definition:
model ModerationAppeal {
  id           String             @id @default(uuid())
  decisionId   String
  decision     ModerationDecision @relation(fields: [decisionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  requesterId  String
  requester    User               @relation(fields: [requesterId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reason       String
  status       String             @default("OPEN")
  assigneeId   String?
  dueAt        DateTime
  resolution   String?
  resolvedById String?
  resolvedAt   DateTime?
  version      Int                @default(1)
  createdAt    DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime           @updatedAt

  @@unique([decisionId, requesterId])
  @@index([status, dueAt])
}

name: SlaEscalation
definition:
model SlaEscalation {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  kind      String
  targetId  String
  dueAt     DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([kind, targetId, dueAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

name: FeatureFlag
definition:
model FeatureFlag {
  key         String   @id
  enabled     Boolean  @default(true)
  rollout     Int      @default(100)
  roles       String[] @default([])
  version     Int      @default(1)
  updatedById String
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

name: AdminTeam
definition:
model AdminTeam {
  id          String            @id @default(uuid())
  name        String            @unique
  description String            @default("")
  isActive    Boolean           @default(true)
  version     Int               @default(1)
  members     AdminTeamMember[]
  tickets     SupportTicket[]
  createdAt   DateTime          @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime          @updatedAt
}

name: AdminTeamMember
definition:
model AdminTeamMember {
  teamId    String
  userId    String
  role      String    @default("MEMBER")
  team      AdminTeam @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  @@id([teamId, userId])
  @@index([userId])
}

name: AdminReportSchedule
definition:
model AdminReportSchedule {
  timezone  String           @default("UTC")
  id        String           @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId   String
  owner     User             @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name      String
  kind      String
  cadence   String
  hourUtc   Int
  isEnabled Boolean          @default(true)
  nextRunAt DateTime
  version   Int              @default(1)
  runs      AdminReportRun[]
  createdAt DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime         @updatedAt

  @@index([isEnabled, nextRunAt])
  @@index([ownerId])
}

name: AdminReportRun
definition:
model AdminReportRun {
  objectKey       String?
  requestKey      String?             @unique
  kind            String
  scheduleVersion Int
  id              String              @id @default(uuid())
  scheduleId      String
  schedule        AdminReportSchedule @relation(fields: [scheduleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scheduledFor    DateTime
  status          String              @default("PENDING")
  attempts        Int                 @default(0)
  availableAt     DateTime            @default(now())
  leaseOwner      String?
  leaseUntil      DateTime?
  payload         String?
  lastError       String?
  completedAt     DateTime?
  expiresAt       DateTime
  createdAt       DateTime            @default(now())

  @@unique([scheduleId, scheduledFor])
  @@index([status, availableAt])
}

name: SupportAttachment
definition:
model SupportAttachment {
  id        String        @id @default(uuid())
  ticketId  String
  ticket    SupportTicket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  filename  String        @unique
  file      UploadedFile  @relation(fields: [filename], references: [filename], onDelete: Restrict)
  internal  Boolean       @default(false)
  sha256    String
  size      Int
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())

  @@index([ticketId, createdAt])
}

name: SupportSavedView
definition:
model SupportSavedView {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId   String
  owner     User     @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name      String
  filters   Json
  version   Int      @default(1)
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([ownerId, name])
}

name: SupportAgentSkill
definition:
model SupportAgentSkill {
  userId   String
  user     User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  category String
  maxOpen  Int    @default(20)

  @@id([userId, category])
}

name: PlatformNotificationPreference
definition:
model PlatformNotificationPreference {
  userId    String   @id
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  email     Boolean  @default(false)
  push      Boolean  @default(false)
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

name: PlatformNotificationDelivery
definition:
model PlatformNotificationDelivery {
  id             String               @id @default(uuid())
  notificationId String
  notification   PlatformNotification @relation(fields: [notificationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  channel        String
  status         String               @default("PENDING")
  attempts       Int                  @default(0)
  availableAt    DateTime             @default(now())
  leaseOwner     String?
  leaseUntil     DateTime?
  lastError      String?
  deliveredAt    DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime             @default(now())

  @@unique([notificationId, channel])
  @@index([status, availableAt])
}

name: FinanceStatement
definition:
model FinanceStatement {
  id          String                 @id @default(uuid())
  propertyId  String
  accountKey  String
  importKey   String                 @unique
  contentHash String
  importedBy  String
  createdAt   DateTime               @default(now())
  lines       FinanceStatementLine[]

  @@index([propertyId, createdAt])
}

name: FinanceStatementLine
definition:
model FinanceStatementLine {
  id          String                          @id @default(uuid())
  statementId String
  statement   FinanceStatement                @relation(fields: [statementId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  accountKey  String
  propertyId  String
  externalId  String
  amount      Int
  occurredAt  DateTime
  reference   String
  status      String                          @default("UNMATCHED")
  paymentId   String?                         @unique
  payment     Payment?                        @relation(fields: [paymentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  receiptId   String?                         @unique
  receipt     BillingReceipt?                 @relation(fields: [receiptId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  proposals   FinanceReconciliationProposal[]
  version     Int                             @default(1)

  @@unique([accountKey, externalId])
  @@index([propertyId, status, occurredAt])
}

name: FinanceReconciliationProposal
definition:
model FinanceReconciliationProposal {
  id           String               @id @default(uuid())
  lineId       String
  line         FinanceStatementLine @relation(fields: [lineId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  paymentId    String?
  receiptId    String?
  action       String
  lineVersion  Int
  reason       String
  makerId      String
  checkerId    String?
  status       String               @default("PENDING")
  reviewReason String?
  createdAt    DateTime             @default(now())
  reviewedAt   DateTime?

  @@index([status, createdAt])
}
